mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.login_id, u.user_name, u.department_id, d.department_code, d.department_name, u.vendor_id, v.vendor_name, u.role, u.active, u.created_at FROM app_user u LEFT JOIN department d ON d.department_id = u.department_id LEFT JOIN vendor v ON v.vendor_id = u.vendor_id ORDER BY u.user_id
